title: Release lorax 0.2.0
description:
Prepare for release:

* [x] `git pull`
* [x] Check [current CRAN check results](https://cran.rstudio.org/web/checks/check_results_lorax.html)
* [x] [Polish NEWS](https://style.tidyverse.org/news.html#news-release)
* [x] `urlchecker::url_check()`
* [x] `devtools::build_readme()`
* [x] `devtools::check(remote = TRUE, manual = TRUE)`
* [x] `devtools::check_win_devel()`
* [ ] Update `cran-comments.md`
* [ ] `git push`
* [ ] Draft blog post

Submit to CRAN:

* [ ] `usethis::use_version('minor')`
* [ ] `devtools::submit_cran()`
* [ ] Approve email

Wait for CRAN...

* [x] Accepted :tada:
* [ ] Finish & publish blog post
* [ ] Add link to blog post in pkgdown news menu
* [x] `usethis::use_github_release()`
* [x] `usethis::use_dev_version(push = TRUE)`
* [ ] Share on social media
* [ ] Slack link to blog post, bluesky, and linkedin in #open-source-comms

title: Installation code buggy
description:
right now the readme is

```r
require(pak)
pak::pak("topepo/lorax)
```

but it should be

```r
require(pak)
pak::pak("topepo/lorax")
```

title: README.Rmd has placeholder text and no rendered README.md
description:
Landed on the repo and noticed two things:

1. The README still has the default usethis skeleton — 
   "The goal of lorax is to ..." and 
   "FILL THIS IN! HOW CAN PEOPLE INSTALL YOUR DEV PACKAGE?" 
   are still there.

2. There's a README.Rmd but no README.md — GitHub renders 
   the raw Rmd source instead of the knitted output, so the 
   code chunks show as plain text rather than running.

Even a one-liner about what the package does and a 
`pak::pak("topepo/lorax")` install line would help anyone 
stumbling across it.

Happy to leave this open as a reminder or close it if 
you're still in early development. Also happy to help with 
tests, documentation, or anything else if useful.
